copy.fb:
Epsonics saved "The Chain" for last.
Full song: https://www.battleofthetechbands.com/go/wM7hSnZJn0A/fb-caption

A high energy finish from Epsilon's band at The Triffid, suits on and Fleetwood Mac's harmonies stacked across three voices. They finished second overall.

Video shot by Aaron Griffiths and Kurt Boldy. Live audio by Nick Forrester.

Proudly powered by Jumbo Interactive. All proceeds to Youngcare, supporting young Australians with high care needs to live with more choice, freedom and dignity.
